banner.title: coredns
banner.tagline: Answers cluster DNS for every pod on the kube-dns Service and forwards everything else to the Talos host resolver.

explainer.title: From a pod lookup to an answer

steps.title: Query
steps.text: A pod asks the kube-dns Service at 10.43.0.10. One of two CoreDNS replicas on control-plane nodes answers.
steps.scene: a small query arrow hitting one of a pair of lit towers

steps.title: Plugins
steps.text: Cluster names go to the kubernetes plugin. AAAA gets NODATA, because the cluster is IPv4 only. Other names are forwarded.

steps.title: Cache
steps.text: Answers are cached with prefetch and serve_stale, so a short upstream outage does not fail every lookup.
steps.scene: a glowing cache vault with a timer ring

steps.title: Forward
steps.text: Unmatched names go to 169.254.116.108, the Talos hostDNS listener, not the node resolv.conf.
steps.scene: a data path leaving a node block toward a DNS beacon

steps.title: Observe
steps.text: Port 9153 exports Prometheus metrics. The ready plugin gates the Pod, and lameduck drains it cleanly.
steps.scene: a metrics gauge beside a signal beacon
